name: a2b-logistics-mcp
title: a2b Logistics Public Read-Only MCP
description: Public read-only MCP-style endpoint for a2b Logistics company overview, services, capabilities, service areas, routing, and inquiry preparation.

authentication.note: Public read-only tools do not require authentication. Write actions and protected integrations are not enabled.

approvalPolicy: Tools may prepare and route inquiries but must not submit forms, send email, call phone numbers, or contact a2b unless the user explicitly approves the exact action.
